topics.title_vi: Thể thao và cơ sở vật chất

tasks.prompt: You have joined a technology club. Answer five profile questions using short phrases.
questions: What is your name?
What technology do you use most?
How often do you visit the club?
What skill would you like to learn?
Who do you usually study with?

tasks.prompt: A club member asks why you joined. Write a reply.
Reply to the three club members.
questions: Which workshop should the club organise next?
Should beginners and advanced members study together?
How can the club attract more members?

tasks.prompt: Write an email to a friend about a change to the club schedule and explain what you plan to do.
Write to the club secretary. Explain why the schedule change is inconvenient and suggest a solution.
You have joined a local sports centre. Answer five profile questions.
questions: Which sport do you enjoy?
How often do you exercise?
What time do you usually train?
Do you prefer indoor or outdoor activities?
Who do you exercise with?

tasks.prompt: A member asks what you like about the sports centre. Write a reply.

questions: Which new class should the centre offer?
Should weekend opening hours be longer?
How could the centre support beginners?

tasks.prompt: Write to a friend about the closure of the swimming pool this weekend and suggest another activity.
Write to the centre manager. Explain how the pool closure affects members and suggest a fair solution.
You have volunteered for a community arts festival. Answer five profile questions.
questions: Which art form do you like?
Have you volunteered before?
Which day can you help?
What task would you prefer?
Who told you about the festival?

tasks.prompt: Another volunteer asks why the festival is important. Write a reply.

questions: Should the festival include more activities for children?
Is it better to hold the event indoors or outdoors?
How can organisers reduce waste during the festival?

tasks.prompt: Write to a friend explaining that an outdoor performance has moved indoors because of the weather.
Write to the festival organiser. Explain a problem with the new venue and propose practical improvements.
